env:
# --- Core ---
ORBIT_CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION=1
APP_URL=https://orbit.example.com
ORBIT_IMAGE=orbit-local:abcdef123456
# ORBIT_CONFIG_APPLIED_VERSION=
# ORBIT_CONFIG_APPLIED_DIGEST=

# --- Authentication ---
ORBIT_AUTH_OIDC=false
OIDC_ISSUER=https://auth.example.com/application/o/orbit/
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=
OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET=
# OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE=/run/orbit-secrets/orbit-oidc-client-secret
OIDC_CALLBACK_URL=https://orbit.example.com/api/auth/callback

# --- Generated secrets and keys ---
SESSION_SECRET_FILE=.orbit-secrets/session-secret
DOCUMENT_KEK_FILE=.orbit-secrets/document-kek
POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=.orbit-secrets/postgres-password
VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=fake-public-key
VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE=/run/orbit-secrets/orbit-vapid-private-key

# --- Deployment ---
# COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=
ORBIT_BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
ORBIT_PORT=3000
COMPOSE_PROFILES=
POSTGRES_DB=orbit
POSTGRES_USER=orbit

# --- Optional services ---
TIKA_URL=
OLLAMA_MODEL=

# --- Observability ---
ORBIT_LOG_LEVEL=info
ORBIT_LOG_FORMAT=text
